_doc: Per-model LLM pricing for the Token Usage cost calculator. Prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens (input/output split). ONLY includes providers that bill per-token — Azure OpenAI and direct OpenAI. GitHub Copilot SDK is billed per-seat ($/user/month) so token counts are surfaced for capacity tracking, not cost — the portal detects SERVICE_TYPE=GitHubCopilot and hides the cost calculator automatically.

_fallback._note: Used when no modelMatcher matches the active Azure OpenAI / OpenAI model — conservative GPT-5-equivalent rate.
